offline_contract: Only this CSV and provenance are needed for plotting; output source paths are audit references, not notebook dependencies.

replaced.reason: first point on a cold host: ~31% of window was sandbox image materialization; 180 s verifier cap truncated 137 verifications

point_splice.inherited_rows: C=128/256/512 rows are byte-identical to the October 15 frozen CSV.

definitions.rollout_window: [model_ready_at, model_ready_at + rollout_wall_seconds], using each result.json. Model/framework startup and final artifact/cleanup latency excluded.
definitions.usable_trajectories: result.progress.episodes_with_usable_trajectory; this is stored usable training trajectories, not reward verification success or resolved tasks.
definitions.terminal_attempts: Harbor terminal_results, including incomplete verification. This is not a count of successful evaluations.
definitions.verified_attempts: Harbor evaluation_completed, including completed zero rewards.
definitions.sandbox_cpu: Aggregate /proc/stat first8 ticks user,nice,system,idle,iowait,irq,softirq,steal. Busy%=100*(sum(delta(first8))-delta(idle)-delta(iowait))/sum(delta(first8)); guest/guest_nice columns excluded to avoid counting guest time twice.
definitions.sandbox_ram: Whole sandbox-host RAM100*(MemTotal-MemAvailable)/MemTotal, using Linux /proc/meminfo kB*1024; includes OS/runtime/VM nonavailable memory, not aenv anonymous memory or GPU VRAM.
definitions.sample_intervals: CPU delta average is constant on each adjacent sample interval; RAM gauge holds the left sample to the next sample. Clip intervals to the strict rollout window; exclude nonpositive intervals, gaps>15s, and invalid/reset CPU deltas. No extrapolation outside available sample pairs.
definitions.resource_means: Duration-weighted utilization over observed valid intervals; uncovered time is excluded, not imputed as idle. Single AWS sandbox host only.
definitions.resource_peak_5s: Maximum fully covered resampled5-second mean anchored at model_ready_at. Bins require complete valid coverage with tolerance1e-5seconds. These are approximately5-second averages, not instantaneous peaks.
definitions.sandbox_ram_total_gib: Observed MemTotal bytes/2^30 on the single AWS sandbox host; constant across samples.
definitions.client_active_requests_mean: Sum of clipped model RPC begin-to-end/error durations divided by the full rollout wall time; pairs matched by(model_client_id,operation_id). This counts client requests in flight, including server queues, network time and failed-call waiting. It is NOT vLLM engine-running requests.
definitions.client_active_requests_peak: Exact maximum concurrent model RPC intervals from event order, with terminal events processed before begin events at equal timestamps. This is an event-derived peak, not a sampled engine request count.
definitions.verifier_exec_timeout_seconds: Historical accidental 180-second native SDK command timeout on October 15 rows; the spliced C=64 rerun uses the corrected deadline (null).
definitions.engine_failure: True only at C512: EngineDeadError appears in the training log and702 model RPCs end in error.
definitions.result_vs_scheduler_state: The rollout runner wrote a completed result after128 terminal groups; all four Slurm jobs later reportedFAILED during Ray teardown. Result completion does not establish all trajectories or verifications succeeded.
definitions.uncertainty: One stochastic run per concurrency, without replicate-based uncertainty. Image cache state and trajectories can vary.
definitions.benchmark_revision: C=64 row is swebench-pro-v2 (clean rerun); C=128/256/512 rows are swebench-pro (October 15 sweep).
